title: As The Boating Season Comes To An End
author: Quest Watersports
summary_html: Quest Watersports stays open year-round for boat trade-ins, winterization, heated storage and financing as the boating season winds down.
body_html:
The Boating Season May Wind Down, But Quest Doesn’t

When the leaves turn gold and the river settles into that quiet autumn hush, we can’t help but reflect on another incredible boating season. Every sunrise cruise, every tubing laugh, every “just one more lap” — you brought the energy; we brought the boats. Teamwork at its finest.

But here’s the best part: while your flip-flops may hibernate, Quest Watersports doesn’t.

Our docks may get frost-kissed, but our shop doors stay wide open. Now’s the perfect time to think ahead for next boating season — trade in, tune up, or upgrade that setup before spring. The off-season is secretly the best season to buy: more attention, more options, and zero dock-side FOMO. Check out our current inventory here: Boat Inventory – Quest Watersports

What’s happening this fall and winter:

  • Fresh boat inventory and trade-ins arriving weekly
  • Certified techs offering winterization, upgrades, and TLC
  • Heated storage options and shrink-wrap protection
  • Financing help with fair evaluations and no pressure

Every boating season, individuals and families alike all enjoy time on the river from the sunshine right down to the warm water splashes.

Whether you’re shopping for your next cruiser or planning your 2026 adventures, we’re here year-round to help you stay afloat — figuratively, at least.

Your year-round crew:

Quest Watersports
Randi Paquette | 815-433-2200 ext. 890 | randi@questwatersports.com

Because the only thing better than a summer on the water… is knowing next summer’s already lined up.

Looking for a place to stay in the area? Heritage Harbor and Harbor Inn provide a riverfront resort experience all year round. For current availability – Harbor Inn at Heritage Harbor.
